change: CORRECTED primary/secondary split. Hamstrings moved from primary to secondary: in the hip thrust, the knee is bent throughout, placing hamstrings in active insufficiency — they assist but are NOT co-primary movers (EMG research confirms glutes dominate at ~229% MVC; hamstring involvement is inconclusive/secondary). Gluteus Maximus + Medius remain primary (band increases Gluteus Medius activation via abduction demand). Added Adductors as secondary: they stabilize the hip and assist in keeping the knees from flaring inward. Removed Lower Back (Erector Spinae) as secondary: with shoulders and feet elevated, spinal load is reduced and Erector Spinae involvement is minimal — replaced by abs for core isometric stabilization.
